selection_basis: Editorial perspectives based on the resource; not measured reader profiles.

readers.label: General understanding
readers.perspective: a reader seeking a general introduction
readers.question: What should remain dependable when software can change more easily?
focus: Information continuity, shared meaning, authority and adaptable implementations.
Independent concepts, including learning at a different rate from operational change.
Stable experiences, parallel choices and one bounded everyday example.

reading.why: Begin with the supplied overall argument.
Understand the paradigm and reversible lifecycle.

See which concerns persist and which adapt.

readers.description: Understand the foundations, how the ideas fit together and what remains to be tested.

readers.title: Liquid Software for business leaders
